runtime.name: codex-cli
runtime.configuration: Generated Skill copied under project .agents/skills; interactive TUI; gpt-6-astra; experimental default_mode_request_user_input enabled; persisted session in disposable HOME and CODEX_HOME directories.
runtime.permissionProfile: Read-only sandbox with approval policy never and native interactive user input

assertions.evidence: The interactive turn received the generated check-interaction Skill from the project .agents/skills inventory before execution.
The persisted session contains exactly one request_user_input_async call with both probe questions.
The queued native question card presented Amber (Recommended), Cobalt, and the host-provided Other choice.
The native question card emitted a user message selecting Cobalt.
The second native question card exposed Other in addition to Alpha and Beta and accepted editable text.
The native question card emitted a separate user message containing violet-42.
The first final INTERACTION_RESULT exactly matches the two native question-card user messages.
The first final result reported timed_out=false and success=true only after both native answers were delivered.
External post-run Git status reported no changes in the disposable probe repository.

limitations: This result applies only to the interactive Codex CLI TUI with the experimental default_mode_request_user_input feature enabled; codex exec behavior is recorded separately as a fallback.

The asynchronous operation returned accepted=true immediately. Answers were queued in the TUI and delivered later as user messages; the active turn had to be interrupted before the queued card could be opened with Option-Up.

A reconnaissance codex queue message submitted before the native card was opened was delivered as a duplicate follow-up after the first successful result. The capability claim is based only on the earlier request_user_input_async call, two native question-card answers, and first final result.
Unrelated installed MCP providers attempted startup in the disposable state directory and emitted authentication warnings; the interaction probe used no MCP provider and completed successfully.
